marquee.headline: Built a segment in Claude last week? Where is it now?
paragraphs: You asked a sharp question. Claude found the customers. Then you closed the window. Gone, and next time the definition won't quite match.
Tydo connects to Shopify once, builds your first segments before you ask, and saves every one as a native Shopify segment. Claude, Sidekick, Flow and the Tydo app all read the same definitions.
Ask Claude for full-price loyalists, meaning customers with three or more orders and no discounted orders, and the result lands in Shopify as a real segment Flow can act on the next day.
bullets: Separate builders for customers, orders and products
Every segment recomputed nightly and updated as orders land
Each segment shown against the whole store, the prior period or last year
A nightly check for new segments worth having
No reconnecting and no per-tool setup

welcome.headline: Your segments should live in one place
paragraphs: Most Shopify brands end up with customer segments spread across too many places: a Klaviyo list, a Shopify filter, a spreadsheet, and lately a Claude chat that disappears when the window closes.

Tydo is a segment builder for Shopify. You connect your store once. It builds a first set of segments for you, recomputes every one nightly and writes them back to Shopify, where Claude, Sidekick and Flow all use the same definitions.
Worth a look before your next retention planning session.
